subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Introduced to the square (sides and corners)

show.line: This is a square. Look with your eyes. Four straight sides and four corners.

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say it with me. Square!
Touch each corner of the square. How many corners?
Which snack is a square? Look with your eyes.
Put the squares in one group and the circles in the other.

hints: A square has straight sides, all the same.
Count the corners. A square has four.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the corners on the square.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A square has four corners.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count them together. One, two, three, four corners!

parent_line: Can recognise a square and count its four sides and corners.
